cases.answer:
Yes. Captains may mutually agree to reschedule a match to another time that day or to another day within the same week.

They must notify League Management at info@lwrpickleballclub.com of the new date and time. Scores must be submitted by Sunday at midnight of that same week. If that deadline cannot be met because of weather or other unforeseen circumstances, the Home Captain must notify the same address before Sunday at midnight with the rescheduled date and time; failure to do so may result in forfeiture.
